takeUp.title: State tree: each node registers its subtree, readers pull with marks
takeUp.intent: One object, addressed by path: state.nodes.<ref>.<child>. Each node registers its OWN subtree in its OWN State registry; readers take the member list from Join and pull each member with their own marks, assembling the tree locally. Done means a node's subtree exists at boot at N=1, a reader assembles N peers in parallel without hanging on a dead one, and the Menu shows every head with its Phoenix cycle counter. No central server, no push, no lease, no TTL.
next: register the node's own subtree at boot from node.json (makes the object exist at N=1)

gate: synthetic peer that advances its cycle, then stalls, then goes silent - prove the three states

takeUp.title: Character voices from a description (Sophion, Destiny, Kate)
takeUp.intent: Three distinct, repeatable character voices that need nobody elses recording: the timbre comes from an instruction string, so the same text recreates the same voice on any node. Done means each character has a fixed instruction kept in a file, an expressive sample set (neutral / happy / sad / angry / laugh) measured for RTF and pitch, and one engine chosen with numbers rather than adjectives.
next: pick the path per sample after listening: the three bases must be told apart with eyes closed
